reviews.text: Excellent vet, attentive, accommodating and flexible, I have complete confidence in them! Highly recommended in the neighborhood, the waiting times for appointments are very reasonable and the prices are too.
A very good veterinarian, who takes the time for her patients, very competent and friendly.
A friendly and gentle vet with animals, reasonable prices, a welcome change from others.
A very kind and caring vet. Takes the time to examine and give good advice.
Warm welcome and I can be present with my cat during the visit and vaccination 😊 …

A huge thank you to the entire team at Cabinet Flammarion! My cat received excellent care for his vaccination, treatment, and neutering. Everything went perfectly; you can tell the animals are in good hands. You have my complete trust! 🥰 …
An excellent vet. Very compassionate and does everything she can to make sure things go as smoothly as possible.
An excellent veterinarian, attentive, patient and gentle.

A huge thank you to Dr. Cottin and his assistant.

This is my second visit. You took excellent care of my cat and did a superb job on her teeth.

It's a pleasure to have such a great team at this veterinary practice.

The telephone reception was wonderful, with a very attentive assistant who provided relevant advice. 👌

The prices are reasonable; I wasn't subjected to any attempts to upsell me on unnecessary services.

They only provided what was truly necessary, with excellent results and genuine care given to all the animals I saw in the practice.

Aska is enjoying a well-deserved nap. Thank you so much! 🌺
Super friendly and gives great advice, a true pro

I came for the first time (I didn't live in Marseille before) for my cat's annual check-up and vaccinations. The vet was attentive, competent, kind, and gave excellent advice.

I'll be back! You can go there with complete confidence.

Dr. Cottin is competent, empathetic, caring, and always offers excellent advice. The assistant is truly lovely, and you can see how much animals are loved in this practice. I can only give 5 stars. Thank you for everything! 🐈‍⬛🐈💕 …
Excellent care provided, vets who take the time to explain things. I recommend them.

A local vet for our cat who lives in the neighborhood.

He doesn't complain too much about his annual visit, thanks to a few treats they give him after his vaccination 💉. Always so attentive to our old Titou 😽 …
